name: Valerie Garcia
tagline: Top rated Civil Litigation attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Valerie Garcia, an attorney with Hall & Evans, LLC in Denver, Colorado, helps clients address Civil Litigation: Defense situations. She also helps clients with Construction Litigation: Business and Personal Injury - Products: Defense concerns.
She received legal training from University of Denver Sturm College of Law. She graduated from law school in 1998. Valerie Garcia became licensed to practice law in 1998.
Valerie Garcia was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that she is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2027.
